messages:
kevin: Quick check — we've got a late-night benchmark job that needs 8 H100 GPUs in us-west2 at 00:30 PT. Can we confirm capacity or a quick plan to reshuffle?

maria: We currently have a soft reservation for 6 H100 in us-west2 (R-3392). Vendor said they can *maybe* patch +2 if we move a demo slice.

sara: I can shift one demo slice off the pool (free up 1), but need to know which tenant to deprioritize. Prefer not to touch prod pipelines.

mike: If we reassign the small nightly-training shard (tenant: analytics-qa) to eu-west temporarily we can free 2. That would get you to 8.

kevin: Nice. Can someone open the terraform PR to patch the reservation or do a transient slot move? I'll need a CLI command to run in the oncall window.

maria: Opening PR now. It patches the reservation count and adds a short-lived label so billing/ops can trace it. Diff is tiny.

kevin: Ping me the PR link when it's up. Also need the gcloud one-liner if we need emergency manual carve:

maria: Use this to list reservations: 
```
gcloud compute reservations list --filter="zone:us-west2* AND machineType:h100*" --format="table(name,zone,commitment)"
```
And to update (manual):
```
gcloud compute reservations update R-3392 --zone=us-west2-a --instance-flexibility=on --commitments=8
```
(we usually prefer infra changes via TF but this can be run by oncall if timing is tight)

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor update: reservation R-3392 — pending patch accepted by provider, ETA ~22 minutes. Ticket #VND-4521.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for us-west2 starts at 6823460000. Expect transient allocation shifts.

mike: Ok that maintenance might actually free ephemeral slots briefly, good timing. I'll coordinate with vendor point-of-contact and keep slack updates here.

sara: If PR is ready share it and I'll approve the demo-slice move. Can we add a short note to the audit log that this is temporary (24h)?

maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/terraform/pull/1287 — adds label `temp:night-benchmark-6823456789` and bumps reservation count to 8. CI lint passed.

kevin: Thanks — I'll queue the oncall runbook: run the gcloud update if PR apply stalls, then start the benchmark at 00:35. Please react when you see the apply finish. :thumbsup:

mike: I'll stand by. If vendor delays, we'll fallback to eu-west bump for analytics-qa and keep the benchmark at 01:00.

maria: Apply started via Terraform Cloud — apply id tfc-apply-772. Expect completion in ~6–8 mins.

sara: Approved, moving demo slice now.

vendor-ops-bot: R-3392 patch completed by provider at 6823459002. Backfill slots available: +2 in us-west2-a.

kevin: Apply succeeded, verified 8 H100 visible in us-west2-a. Starting warmup KV cache and then the benchmark. Will post results.

mike: Great. Logging this as transient capacity borrow: note in ticket ENG-ops: we used vendor patch + tenant reassign, revert label in 24h.

kevin: Results: throughput looks nominal, no OOMs. Thanks all. I'll close the loop in the incident ticket and remove the temp label tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
